We started yhangry as a side hustle in 2019. At the time, we were both super busy, working in finance. As people who love hosting but didn’t have the time to cook elaborate meals, we wanted to find a chef to cook for our dinner parties. So we decided to create a platform that would solve our problems of finding chefs and make it easy for others to do the same.
was in fixed-income sales at Goldman Sachs and Barclays, covering hedge funds and German institutional asset managers for credit products.

At yhangry, our mission is to empower both our customers and our chefs. By offering affordable access to the luxury of private dining, we make it possible for anyone to create unforgettable memories with their loved ones.

In the summer of 2019, we were accepted into the Google for Startups female founders residency program, and we decided to quit our jobs and work on yhangry full-time. We then bootstrapped, built and released our first website in December 2019, just before the pandemic hit.

During the first lockdown, we had to pivot to virtual cooking classes and meal prep delivery from our chefs’ homes, which helped us stay afloat during a difficult time. In November 2020, we pitched in
and received offers from two Dragons, ultimately securing a £100k deal on screen. However, we chose to walk away from the deal in private and instead raised

, a prestigious startup program and the first backer of Airbnb. They helped us strengthen the business, and with a team of 11 employees, almost 1000 chefs across the UK, we have now cooked for more than 40,000 guests.

At Yhangry, we are always on the lookout for individuals passionate about revolutionising the private dining experience. We aim to transform how people celebrate life’s moments by making private dining accessible, seamless, and memorable. We’re not just building a company; we’re creating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and customer delight.

We celebrate diversity and recognise that unique perspectives are key to our success. Whether working remotely or in person, we prioritise building strong connections within our team. We’re big believers in continuous learning and provide opportunities for professional development to help you grow alongside us.
